title: 第030章 归宗养晦修残道，临堂辩议镇群言
content_zh:
华英杰一脸感概地坐在墙角，这种被人研究的感觉实在是不怎么美丽，却又无可奈何。

    李道然忽然间感觉有一阵清凉的微风拂过，他惊讶d地看向了那原本两年国企潮汐的源头，那里再次出现了海量的灵气。

    而在看到李道然之后，这些海族的第一反应不是冲上来，而是看向了一个海族，大声的质问。

    白胜奇冷哼一声，落地之后双手凝聚一个个黑色的能量球，向唐明和金子仔发动攻击。

    唐明捂着脖子，难以置信地看着柳梦婷，这丫头是疯到了什么程度，竟然连他都杀？

    四周无数修士还在对着林毅躬身行礼，感谢林族弃徒之声不绝于耳。

    “秦将军，可是感染了风寒？要不要找大夫看看。”李靖关心的问着。

    见到这一幕，叶晨不由得大喝一声，与此同时，他与苏七星的身上均是闪出了莹莹白光，就在那断臂即将刺入苏七星背后时，二人的身影齐齐消失，再次出现时，二人的位置已然调换。

    邵无仇直接召唤出一把重机枪，对周围的怪我进行疯狂扫射，唐明则是将华英杰丢在中间，不停游走击杀漏网之鱼。

    其他所有的年轻人都闻言起立向舒伯特围拢过来，很明显这些都是准备代表美因克在交流大会上出战的炼金学徒们。

    “我知道你想说啥，说我吃软不吃硬？”西格看向云淼，一副自己很聪明的样子吧。

    “我还就不信邪了。”蒋飞拿起手机，准备给方震林打电话，他听说了方震林在码头，苏诗雅家中的遭遇，方震林一定想复仇。

    皇后双手合十，无声的承诺着，又把密信看了一遍又一遍，直到能背出信里的一字一句，才将密信点燃，看着火花飞舞，密信化为了灰烬。
content_en:
Hua Yingjie sat in the corner with a look of emotion on his face. This feeling of being studied was not very beautiful, but he was helpless.

    Li Daoran suddenly felt a cool breeze blowing by. He looked in surprise at the source of the two-year state-owned enterprise tide, where a massive amount of spiritual energy appeared again.

    After seeing Li Daoran, the first reaction of these sea tribesmen was not to rush forward, but to look at one of the sea tribesmen and question him loudly.

    Bai Shengqi snorted coldly. After landing, he condensed black energy balls in his hands and launched an attack on Tang Ming and Jin Zizi.

    Tang Ming covered his neck and looked at Liu Mengting in disbelief. How crazy was this girl to kill him?

    Countless monks around were still bowing to Lin Yi, and the voices of thanking the Lin clan for abandoning their disciples could not be heard.

    "General Qin, are you infected with the cold? Do you want to see a doctor?" Li Jing asked with concern.

    Seeing this scene, Ye Chen couldn't help but shout. At the same time, he and Su Qixing's bodies flashed with white light. Just when the severed arm was about to pierce Su Qixing's back, the two figures disappeared together. When they appeared again, their positions had been reversed.

    Shao Wuchou directly summoned a heavy machine gun and fired wildly at the surrounding monsters. Tang Ming left Hua Yingjie in the middle and kept swimming around to kill the fish that slipped through the net.

    All the other young people stood up and gathered around Schubert after hearing this. It was obvious that these were alchemy apprentices who were preparing to represent Meink at the exchange conference.

    "I know what you want to say, are you saying that I am a softie but not a tough one?" Sig looked at Yun Miao, looking like he was very smart.

    "I don't believe in evil yet." Jiang Fei picked up his cell phone and was about to call Fang Zhenlin. He heard about what happened to Fang Zhenlin at the dock and Su Shiya's home. Fang Zhenlin must want revenge.

    The queen clasped her hands together and made a silent promise. She read the secret letter over and over again until she could recite every word in the letter, then lit the secret letter on fire and watched the sparks fly and the secret letter turn into ashes.
title_en: Chapter 030: Returning to the clan, keeping a low profile and cultivating the disabled way, and debating the opinions of the people in the hall
